name: noxi
description: Create, edit, read and export NOXI presentations from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: NOXI is an AI presentation maker for work. It turns a topic, a brief or an outline into a complete, professionally designed slide deck in your NOXI account, using the same engine as noxi.ai. From the chat you can create a presentation (optionally grounded in fresh web research or built from an exact outline), change slides in plain words with NOXI's AI editor, find and read your presentations and templates, and export PDF, PowerPoint or a single-file HTML web version. After a deck is created or changed, NOXI prepares its PDF, PowerPoint and HTML files automatically, and a card in the chat shows the progress, slide previews and the files. Long tasks run in the background and the assistant follows them to completion. Slides are written in the language you ask for, including right-to-left languages such as Arabic. NOXI only works with presentations in the account you connect.
capabilities: Find and read your NOXI presentations and templates
Create designed presentations from a topic, brief or outline
Edit slides with NOXI's AI editor
Export presentations as PDF, PowerPoint or HTML
Show slide previews and the files in a card in the chat
defaultPrompt: Create a 10-slide NOXI presentation about our Q3 product launch.
Export my latest NOXI presentation as a PowerPoint file.
